text:
anya (Finance): Quick ping daily cost alert shows a 31% jump on the "staging-gpu" pool for July; attributed to project=redwood-internal, team= (blank). Anyone seeing label drift?
cost-bot: Alert: gpu-spike | pool=staging-gpu | over_by=31% | window=24h | link=https://alerts.redwood/8201 :rotating_light:
devon (Eng-Infra): Hm, we rolled a deployment to the autoscaler group yesterday. I pushed a change that replaced instance-labels with metadata keys; labels.team might have been dropped.
sam (Eng-ML): That matches: a set of ephemeral training jobs were scaled up for hyperparam sweep. They use autoscaled VMs that rely on labels.team for billing. If missing, costs flow to "unassigned" bucket.
izzy (PlatformOps): I can run a targeted resource query and produce a CSV of affected instances. Quick query: `SELECT instance_id, labels, project FROM billing.resources WHERE pool='staging-gpu' AND DATE(usage_start) BETWEEN '2024-07-10' AND '2024-07-11'`
anya (Finance): Can we backfill labels so we can charge the right team before monthly showback? Also mute the alert while we fix.
devon (Eng-Infra): I'll revert the autoscaler template to include labels.team and add a CI gate to prevent label-less rollouts. PR will be posted in infra channel. ETA 4h.
sam (Eng-ML): I'll aggregate job manifests to map owner -> run-time per job so we can proportionally allocate the unlabeled cost if backfill can't directly map each VM.
izzy (PlatformOps): CSV uploaded: https://storage.redwood/finance/staging-unmapped-1748001234.csv Total unlabeled cost over window = $9,450. Also started backfill job to write label mappings to billing table; job id=bfill-1748.
cost-bot: Alert muted by anya (Finance) for 8h on #finance per mute policy.
anya (Finance): Good. Action list: izzy run full-month backfill and attach results (due: 2024-07-12 09:00), devon revert template + CI gate (due: 2024-07-12 EOD), sam prepare run-owner mapping for chargeback (due: 2024-07-12 11:00). Finance will hold reassignments until backfill completes.
devon (Eng-Infra): Posted PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1147 adding required labels and a unit test. Rolling patch now.
izzy (PlatformOps): Backfill job completed. Results: mapped $8,900 to eng-ml (70%), ops-platform (30%). CSV: https://storage.redwood/finance/staging-backfill-results-1748001234.csv
anya (Finance): Thanks. I'll update the showback and re-open the budget alert if drift continues. Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
